summary: No new bytes written this turn: the file already on disk is the update accepted in the previous turn, so this is a no-op resubmission that the controller will record as unchanged. The run's substantive work is complete and standing. Three lines, each with a fixed experiment, retained receipts and a current account: (1) VerifyLeader can be confirmed by a non-voter's acknowledgement, so a leader that has lost every other voter keeps reporting success for its whole configured lease - an answer to the gap, two executions of the extended window plus the pre-window controls, scoped defect claim asserted; (2) the suspected demotion-view lag was refuted across seven sampled runs and that question is closed; (3) LeadershipTransferToServer aimed at a non-voter returns success indistinguishable from a real handover while the sitting leadership is interrupted and a fresh election decides the outcome, bounded by the observed recovery, claim asserted. Knowledge was promoted with receipts for all three behaviours, and the one remaining open item is the registered gap about the isolated near_node_self_voter field of the extended-window harness, which is documented, does not affect any claim, and now has an owner. Nothing further was submitted because the remaining allocation cannot cover executing and interpreting another receipt, and expiry preserves the existing work without a closing call.
